subject: Draft MAP + evaluation rhythm for HelioHealth pilot
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@heliohealth.com>, Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + evaluation rhythm for HelioHealth pilot

Hi Lina + Ethan —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion I sketched a lightweight MAP (Mutual Action Plan) you can use to align internal stakeholders and accelerate the pilot. The doc focuses on three lanes: business success metrics, technical validation, and procurement/ops milestones.

High level proposal in the attached stub:
- Week 0: access + security intake (security Qs + SSO test)
- Week 1: integration spike + sample inference run (SLO: <200ms p95 for 512 tokens)
- Week 2-3: feature proofs and UX iteration with 1–2 demo cycles
- Week 4: acceptance criteria check and pilot wrap (pass/fail checklist + metrics)

Request for you: please add stakeholder names for ownership (legal, security, infra) and any hard constraints on procurement/timing (e.g., PO window or budget committee dates).

I attached a GDoc stub and a 2-slide onramp deck. Marissa, Jasmine — looping you in to help co-author the technical tasks and to capture the SLOs we committed to. Ben, please note the procurement callout — Helio mentioned a Nov 5th procurement meeting on our call.

Next steps: Lina to populate owners and a preferred go/no-go date; we’ll iterate and finalize a MAP by Mon 10/25 so the pilot can kick off Nov 1st if all checks pass.

Thanks —
Grace
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-template-helio-v1.gdoc (stub), week1-onramp-slides.pptx (stub), security-questions.xlsx (stub)

From: Lina Park <lina.park@heliohealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation rhythm for HelioHealth pilot

Grace—

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I dropped a few notes in the doc and added owners for Legal (Priya N.), Security (Samir K.), and Product (Ethan). A couple of constraints from my side:
- Procurement cadence: our vendor review happens 11/04 (committee meets every first Thursday) — realistically we need a signed SOW by 10/28 to make that meeting.
- Data policy: we need confirmation on what telemetry Redwood retains and for how long — Samir will push a short checklist.

On the technical side Ethan asked if we can shift the integration spike to include a small token-cost estimate for our expected 100k token/day pattern. Also, can we define the 1–2 demo cycles as fixed review checkpoints (we suggested Tue mornings to align with Product).

I’ll keep editing the MAP doc and flag acceptance criteria we care about (accuracy thresholds + latency bands).

Best,
Lina
Head of Product
HelioHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@heliohealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation rhythm for HelioHealth pilot

Thanks Lina — great context. Quick answers and edits: 
- Procurement: noted the 11/04 vendor review. Grace / Ben — can we commit to a signed SOW by 10/28 if Helio gives final tech OK by 10/22? I penciled that dependency into the MAP with a canary fallback (extend pilot start by 2 weeks if SOW misses committee).
- Data retention: Jasmine and I added a short note in the security questions file. Short answer: hosted API telemetry is retained for 30 days by default, with enterprise retention options and KMS-based controls available for Private deployments. Jasmine, can you confirm the exact phrasing we should use for Helio (they're sensitive to retention windows)?
- Token estimate: Ben, can you draft a first-pass cost delta for 100k tokens/day with the pilot config we discussed (standard batching + cache TTL 30s)? Put the estimate in the MAP doc under "Pilot economics".

Operational asks for Helio (so we can finalize on 10/25):
1) Confirm procurement window + who signs the SOW.
2) Add security reviewer contact and completion date for the intake.
3) Confirm two Tue morning demo slots (we suggested 10/26, 11/02).

I updated the GDoc link with a simple acceptance matrix (pass if accuracy >= 85% on the heldout sample and latency p95 < 250ms). Grace — I left the SLO numbers as discussable.

-Marissa
Head of Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@heliohealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation rhythm for HelioHealth pilot

On Mon, Oct 18, 2026 at 03:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Lina — great context. Quick answers and edits:
> - Procurement: noted the 11/04 vendor review. Grace / Ben — can we commit to a signed SOW by 10/28 if Helio gives final tech OK by 10/22? I penciled that dependency into the MAP with a canary fallback (extend pilot start by 2 weeks if SOW misses committee).

Thanks everyone — this looks good. A few clarifications from Product: 
- We can target the 10/22 tech signoff if Redwood provides an integration checklist and a sample payload schema by 10/15. Lina will coordinate our internal reviewers on that schedule.
- Regarding telemetry retention: Samir will accept the 30-day default as long as we get documentation on deletion controls and an export of logs on request. Jasmine — can you attach the retention language + the KMS option in the doc?

We confirmed Tue morning demo windows for 10/26 and 11/02. I also added the procurement approver (Sandra B., VP of Ops) into the MAP owners list.

Next: Grace — once you upload the next MAP revision with Ben's cost numbers and Jasmine's security wording, we can lock the 10/22 tech signoff and aim for 10/28 SOW submission.

Best,
Ethan
Senior Product Manager
HelioHealth
